input.format: OKX unified bill history ZIP containing one UTF-8 BOM CSV

inference.exit_candidate: opposite side order group with non-zero realized PnL
inference.ambiguous_opposite_zero_order: end current candidate and start a new candidate
inference.position_reconstruction: approximate; do not treat as exact FIFO positions

walk_forward.selection_metric: train net PnL, then profit factor

candidate_policies.name: all_closed_episodes
candidate_policies.description: All inferred closed episodes; descriptive baseline only

candidate_policies.name: short_no_recent_6h_loss
candidate_policies.description: Do not open a short when the same symbol lost in the prior six hours

candidate_policies.name: short_no_recent_24h_loss
candidate_policies.description: Do not open a short when the same symbol lost in the prior 24 hours

candidate_policies.name: long_only
candidate_policies.description: Directional comparison for the less frequent long style

candidate_policies.name: long_no_recent_6h_loss
candidate_policies.description: Keep long entries only when the same symbol had no recent six-hour loss

candidate_policies.name: long_no_recent_24h_loss
candidate_policies.description: Keep long entries only when the same symbol had no recent 24-hour loss

candidate_policies.name: any_no_recent_6h_loss
candidate_policies.description: Keep either direction only when the symbol had no recent six-hour loss

candidate_policies.name: any_no_recent_24h_loss
candidate_policies.description: Keep either direction only when the symbol had no recent 24-hour loss

price_backtest.entry_rule: first confirmed candle whose start is strictly after the bill episode entry timestamp

candidate_policies.name: all_behavior_entries
candidate_policies.description: Replay every simulated bill episode entry with fixed risk management

candidate_policies.name: short_only
candidate_policies.description: Replay only the dominant short direction

candidate_policies.name: long_only
candidate_policies.description: Replay only the less frequent long direction

candidate_policies.name: short_after_24h_up_10pct
candidate_policies.description: Short labels only after a prior 24 hour rise of at least 10 percent

candidate_policies.name: short_after_24h_up_20pct
candidate_policies.description: Short labels only after a prior 24 hour rise of at least 20 percent

candidate_policies.name: short_near_24h_high
candidate_policies.description: Short labels only when price is within 5 percent of its prior 24 hour high

runtime_integration.reason: bill-level research experiment; not a production signal generator
